label.purpose: Timestamps, shortcut keycaps, and telemetry metadata.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid stark action button for confirmations, submissions, and key actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #1f2328; color: #ffffff; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.15); transform: translateY(-0.5px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Bordered resting button for alternate choices and tool toggles.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #f6f8fa; color: #1f2328; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; border: 1px solid #d0d7de; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #ffffff; border-color: #8c959f; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Low-emphasis icon button or toolbar toggle without persistent borders.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #656d76; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #f6f8fa; color: #1f2328; }

components.name: Search Input Field
components.description: Standardized search and jump field with inset icon.
components.css: .ds-search-box { position: relative; width: 100%; } .ds-search-input { width: 100%; padding: 6px 12px 6px 30px; font-size: 12px; color: #1f2328; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #d0d7de; border-radius: 8px; outline: none; transition: all 0.15s ease; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.02); } .ds-search-input:focus { border-color: #1f2328; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(31, 35, 40, 0.1); }

components.name: Floating Frosted Composer
components.description: Floating glassmorphic composer container for prompt input.
components.html: gemini-2.5-flash
components.css: .ds-composer { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border: 1px solid #d0d7de; border-radius: 18px; padding: 12px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(31, 35, 40, 0.08), 0 8px 24px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06), 0 16px 32px -8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08); display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 100%; max-width: 800px; } .ds-composer-textarea { width: 100%; background: transparent; border: none; outline: none; font-size: 14px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; resize: none; color: #1f2328; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-composer-footer { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 8px; padding-top: 8px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(208, 215, 222, 0.5); } .ds-model-chip { font-size: 11px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; background: #f6f8fa; border: 1px solid #d0d7de; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; color: #656d76; } .ds-send-btn { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #1f2328; color: #ffffff; border: none; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-weight: bold; }

components.name: Tool Execution Card
components.description: Collapsible card detailing tool name, status ticker, args, and output.
components.css: .ds-tool-card { background: #f6f8fa; border: 1px solid #d0d7de; border-radius: 14px; padding: 12px 14px; width: 100%; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-tool-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-tool-name { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; color: #1f2328; } .ds-tool-status { font-size: 11px; color: #1a7f37; font-weight: 500; }

narrative.overview:
Sirona is an autonomous developer agent desktop studio designed around the feeling of a quiet, hyper-focused, unhurried instrument cockpit. Where conventional developer tools overwhelm users with dense terminal logs, erratic font weights, and chaotic layouts, Sirona brings absolute visual clarity: complex agentic workflows—such as multi-turn reasoning chains, tool execution loops, and git diff trees—are structured into legible, transparent visual controls.

The interface prioritizes high-contrast typography, ample tranquil negative space, and disciplined layout rhythm. Built for non-technical power users as well as experienced engineers, the system translates low-level system events into plain-language summaries and intuitive visual affordances.
keyCharacteristics: Chromatic Rarity: A stark, intentional monochrome foundation where color is never decorative and is strictly reserved for operational status and safety gates.
Layered Ambient Depth: Elevation achieved through 0.5–1px hairline borders and multi-layer downward ambient diffusion rather than harsh heavy dropshadows.
Frosted Glass Focal Point: A floating, translucent composer pinned to the viewport bottom that commands attention while letting chat history drift cleanly underneath.
Precision Squircles: A unified radius hierarchy ranging from 6px badges to 18px composer shells.
Zero-Flicker Streaming: Smooth Nanostores reactivity rendering tokens and reasoning deltas without jarring layout shifts.

rules.name: The Chromatic Rarity Rule
rules.body: Color is never decorative. Chromatic hues appear on ≤3% of any viewport, strictly signaling operational state (danger, success, connection heartbeat). Everything else lives in stark monochrome.

rules.name: The Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: All text elements must achieve a minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio against their immediate background; secondary metadata must not drop below 3.5:1.

rules.name: The Monospace Legibility Rule
rules.body: Code blocks, token counts, file paths, tool names, execution durations, and timestamps must always render in monospace with explicit tabular numbers (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

rules.name: The Centered Focus Rule
rules.body: The primary conversation thread and composer must always stay centered within the available main canvas with an 800px maximum constraint, while side rails dock flush to the window perimeters.

rules.name: The Ambient Separation Rule
rules.body: Surfaces separate from the background primarily through a 1px hairline border (var(--dt-border)) reinforced by soft ambient falloff. Heavy 3D bevels, colored drop shadows, and high-opacity borders are strictly prohibited.

rules.name: The Radius Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Interactive inner controls must have a smaller radius than their containing parent card (e.g., an 8px button sits inside a 14px card, never vice versa).

dos: Do wrap every code snippet, file path, command, and timestamp in monospace typography.
Do provide an explicit plain-language summary before displaying tool execution results or code diffs.
Do confine transcript and composer widths to 800px to maintain optimal line-length legibility.
Do preserve 1px hairline borders (var(--dt-border)) between panels and split panes.
Do bind clear keyboard shortcuts (Enter, Esc, ⌘K, ⌘B) to all modals and approval dialogs.
Do respect system reduced-motion preferences (prefers-reduced-motion) by collapsing animations to 0.01ms.
donts: Don't use colored backgrounds for message containers or cards; keep surfaces in pure paper or muted mist.
Don't apply bright chromatic accent colors (blues, greens, purples) to non-status UI elements.
Don't use heavy, opaque drop shadows or thick 2px borders.
Don't display raw JSON dumps or terminal exceptions to users without an accompanying friendly explanation.
Don't auto-scroll the conversation transcript when the user has scrolled up to inspect history.
Don't allow long message lines to stretch across the full width of wide displays.
